fusions.name: Spooked Snap
fusions.desc: Fires a round into the first enemy in its path for 4 damage, and your movement speed rises 15% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Scatter the Herd
fusions.desc: Fires a shot overhead whose report deals 11 resonating damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks each one back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Hair-Trigger
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Startled Sidestep
fusions.desc: Once every 12 seconds, a blow you failed to dodge is rolled again, and the second roll stands.
